    The circular variance is defined as 1 - R, where R is the mean resultant vector.

    Parameters
    ----------
    a : np.ndarray
        A 1-dimensional array of complex numbers.

    Returns
    -------
    float
        The circular variance of the array.
    """
    # Compute the mean resultant vector
    r = np.mean(np.abs(a))
